jamie: quick handoff from overnight — started at ~02:10 UTC. We hit intermittent 502/504s for a subset of Dedicated embeddings customers in eu-west-1. Root cause appears to be the embed-writer background writeback job saturating disk IO on the dedicated pool nodes (gpu-node-emb-7 / gpu-node-emb-8). I paged storage at 02:15 and started triage.
incident-bot: [INCIDENT] 2026-03-05T02:12Z P1 - dedicated-embeddings i/o saturation - pages sent to oncall@redwood and storage@redwood
leo: saw the spike in iowait and enqueue. quick ps + iostat showed heavy fsync cycles from embed-writer process. logs show repeated flushes on batch close.
maria: tailing writer logs, sample (02:08-02:18):
```
[02:08:12] embed-writer batch_id=788 flush_start
[02:08:12] embed-writer fsync start file=/mnt/dedicated/ebuf/part-32
[02:08:14] embed-writer fsync complete dur=2.1s
[02:09:00] embed-writer batch_id=789 flush_start
[02:09:00] embed-writer fsync start file=/mnt/dedicated/ebuf/part-33
[02:09:03] embed-writer fsync complete dur=3.2s
```
maria: looks like back-to-back fsync + long tail which explains the node-level queueing.
ops-bot: executed mitigation: scaled embed-writer backoff and drained replica gpu-node-emb-8 at 02:25 UTC. Command run:
```
kubectl -n dedicated patch deployment embed-writer --type='json' -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/0/value","value":"300"}]'
kubectl drain gpu-node-emb-8 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```
ops-bot: traffic rerouted to eu-west-1-primary and hosted fallback pool while drain completed. No config rollbacks.
leo: after drain, p95 latency for affected routes dropped from ~1.8s -> 0.35s; error rate from ~12% -> ~1.5%. I monitored for 30m, no regressions.
jamie: current status at 05:00 UTC: mitigation in place, error rates near baseline but not fully cleared for a few customers still retrying. Customer impact: subset of Dedicated customers with writeback enabled saw failures/duplicate writes; no data loss observed, only retries. Affected customers list saved to STORAGE-4321.
sophia: I'll own the follow-up: will open STORAGE-4321 (assigned to storage-team) and a follow-up tech task EMB-IO-LIMITER in infra backlog. Plan: add an IO-rate limiter in embed-writer and switch fsync cadence to buffered write + periodic durable checkpoint.
arun: I'm scheduled primary for the 09:00-17:00 UTC shift today. sophia is secondary. Note: I have a short PTO 12:00-15:00 UTC — leo volunteered to cover that window (confirmed).
jamie: coverage notes — APAC morning gap still exists (no dedicated secondary covering 00:00-08:00 JST). If anyone in APAC can take an on-call overlap shift please ping. Right now coverage is: primary arun (09-17 UTC), secondary sophia, backup leo. If you pick up APAC overlap add yourself to /oncall/rotation.
leo: added a minimal playbook snippet to the incident doc — core runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embedding-io
jamie: handoff checklist (short):
• What happened: embed-writer fsync storms saturated disk IO in dedicated eu-west-1 pool causing transient 502/504 for embeddings writeback.
• What we did: drained one replica, increased embed-writer backoff, rerouted traffic to fallback pools, paged storage, monitored until metrics recovered.
• Current status: mitigations active, error rate ~1-2%, p95 recovered.
• Next steps: storage to investigate fsync pattern and filesystem knobs (STORAGE-4321), infra/eng to add IO limiter + queued fsync design (EMB-IO-LIMITER), run a canary deploy next night, notify affected customers via CS.
• Owners: storage-team -> triage STORAGE-4321 (sophia owner), infra -> EMB-IO-LIMITER (leo owner), oncall followup (arun primary this shift).
• Runbooks & artifacts: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embedding-io, incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/3623456789-embed-io
jamie: any blockers for handoff? otherwise passing to arun at 09:00 UTC. please ack.
arun: ack — I'll take primary at 09:00 UTC, will monitor the canary deploy later today. will update this thread if anything changes. :thumbsup:
sophia: ack, will open STORAGE-4321 and drop initial investigation notes in the ticket. will schedule a quick sync with storage tomorrow 10:00 UTC.
jamie: thanks team. leaving notes in PagerDuty and the incident doc. if anything spikes before 09:00 tag @arun and @sophia. :rotating_light:
